children: The Richmond Fed Fifth District Service Sector Survey was flat in September 2026, with the revenues index rising to 0 from -8, while the demand index inched down to 2 from 3.
Current business conditions improved, with the local business conditions index rising to -8 in September from -12 in August, while the future conditions index fell to 0 from 9.
The current employment index fell to 2 in September from 8 in August, while the forward-looking employment index edged lower but remained positive.
On prices, the average growth rate of prices paid decreased somewhat in September, while prices received increased a bit.
Over the next 12 months, firms expected growth in prices paid to remain broadly stable, while anticipating a slight moderation in prices received.
Looking ahead, firms remained relatively optimistic, as expectations for future revenues, demand and local conditions stayed firmly positive.

title: US Fifth District Services Index Flat in September
